nodes.statement: The Corollaries are a consequence of a series of results examining the deeper consequences of smooth Koopman eigenfunctions. See Figure for an overview of the main theoretical results and their logical dependencies. Theorems , , are presented in Section , where we explore the consequences of a single Koopman eigenfunction. In Section~ we explore the additional consequences of the eigenfunctions being smooth. These consequences are stated precisely in Theorems and . All these results are combined in Section to derive our main result Theorem . A collection of smooth, independent Koopman eigenfunctions are used to construct a series of vector fields, each of which is a successive spectral ``simplification'' of the original flow, and we end with a discrete map that isolates the continuous or chaotic component of the flow. The consequences of this deconstruction are explored in Section .
